title: Unit 8 — Project: Solar-Panel Analysis and Report
description: Use MATLAB and the supplied equations to compare three solar-panel systems for a campus charging station. Clean the shared measurements, calculate component costs, classify each system with if/elseif/else in evaluate_system, and support your recommendation with two figures and a 3–4 page technical report.
note: Both MATLAB starters and the exact simulated CSV are preloaded. Open the assignment guide for equations, data rules and report requirements. Run Tests provides programming feedback; it does not grade the PDF or submit to Canvas. Submit LastName_SolarStation_Report.pdf and all completed .m files. Export figures using the existing PNG controls.
